title: Anthraquinone derivative C10 inhibits proliferation and cell cycle progression in colon cancer cells via the Jak2/Stat3 signaling pathway.
authors: Li, Yuying; Guo, Fang; Chen, Tinggui; Zhang, Liwei; Qin, Yu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究蒽醌衍生物C10通过Jak2/Stat3信号通路抑制结肠癌细胞增殖，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Since its discovery, anthraquinone has become very valuable as a lead compound in the development of anti-cancer drugs. Previously, we designed and synthesized a new type of amide anthraquinone derivative (1-nitro-2-acylanthraquinone glycine, C10) with good activity against colon cancer. However, its effect and the underlying mechanism are unclear. In this study, C10 significantly inhibited the proliferation of HCT116 and HT29 colon cancer cells by blocking the cell cycle at the G2/M phase. C10 also plays a role in cell cycle arrest by reducing the protein and gene expression levels of cyclin B1 and its downstream signaling molecule cyclin-dependent kinase (CDK1). In addition, molecular docking studies showed that C10 has high affinity for Jak2, the first target in the cell cycle-related Jak2/Stat3 signaling pathway. Furthermore, C10 downregulated the expression of Jak2/Stat3 signaling pathway-related signaling molecules proteins and genes, and up-regulated the expression of PIAS-3, the upstream signaling molecule of Stat3, thereby down-regulating Stat3 phosphorylation. C10 reversed the expression of Jak2/Stat3 signaling pathway-related molecules activated by IL-6. Overall, our results indicate for the first time that C10 induces cell cycle arrest and inhibits cell proliferation by inhibiting the Jak2/Stat3 signaling pathway. This study provides new insights into the potential role of Jak2/Stat3 in the regulating cell cycle-related signaling pathways that mediate the inhibitory effects of C10 on colon cancer cell proliferation.
abstract_zh: 自发现以来，蒽醌作为抗癌药物开发中的先导化合物变得极具价值。此前，我们设计并合成了一种新型酰胺蒽醌衍生物（1-硝基-2-酰基蒽醌甘氨酸，C10），对结肠癌具有良好的活性。然而，其作用及潜在机制尚不清楚。在本研究中，C10通过将细胞周期阻滞在G2/M期，显著抑制了HCT116和HT29结肠癌细胞的增殖。C10还通过降低细胞周期蛋白B1及其下游信号分子细胞周期蛋白依赖性激酶（CDK1）的蛋白质和基因表达水平，在细胞周期阻滞中发挥作用。此外，分子对接研究表明，C10对Jak2具有高亲和力，Jak2是细胞周期相关Jak2/Stat3信号通路中的首个靶点。进一步地，C10下调了Jak2/Stat3信号通路相关信号分子蛋白质和基因的表达，并上调了Stat3上游信号分子PIAS-3的表达，从而下调Stat3的磷酸化。C10逆转了由IL-6激活的Jak2/Stat3信号通路相关分子的表达。总体而言，我们的结果首次表明，C10通过抑制Jak2/Stat3信号通路诱导细胞周期阻滞并抑制细胞增殖。本研究为Jak2/Stat3在调节介导C10对结肠癌细胞增殖抑制作用的细胞周期相关信号通路中的潜在作用提供了新见解。
